scope: Munich primary/secondary, including same-class intersections; four-arm candidates only in priority groups.
method: Outgoing motor-traffic directions at a provisional rectangle 12m beyond grouped contact nodes. Surface roads only. Explicit lanes:forward/backward, or oneway lanes; opposing and both_ways lanes excluded. Equal splits are estimates only. No defaults for missing lanes. Lane totals may include bus lanes. Grouping <=80m with two common street names is provisional; unnamed, grade-separated or atypical junctions may be missed. Search rectangles are not navigation polygons; manual geometry/road-arm review remains required.
